data.name: Waves Survive
data.detailed_description:
Step into a wild and mysterious world where you must fight to survive. Gather resources, craft tools, build your shelter, and prepare to face dangerous waves of enemies.

Start with almost nothing and turn a small shelter into your own settlement. Explore the world, collect resources, grow plants, build structures, and prepare your defenses before night falls.

Can you survive the next wave?

  • Survive in an open world! Explore forests, coasts, and different areas while gathering the resources you need to survive.

  • Gather, craft, and build! Collect wood, stone, and other materials to create tools, weapons, useful items, and structures.

  • Build your own settlement! Place houses, beds, workbenches, defenses, and other structures to create your base.

  • Don't survive alone! Build houses and place beds to attract new villagers who can become part of your settlement.

  • Prepare for the waves! When enemies arrive, you must defend your base and fight to keep your home and villagers safe.

  • Discover different weapons! Craft weapons and tools to face the dangers you encounter throughout your adventure.

  • Grow plants and gather resources from nature! Find trees, plants, bushes, and other resources to help you stay alive.

  • Survive day and night! Manage your resources and prepare for the dangers that may appear when you least expect them.

  • Play your own way! Decide what to build, how to organize your settlement, and which strategies to use to survive.

Waves Survive combines survival, resource gathering, crafting, settlement building, and wave defense in a pixel art world full of dangers and possibilities.

data.short_description: You find yourself alone in a wild and unknown land. Gather resources, build a shelter, and fight to survive as dangerous waves of enemies threaten to destroy everything you've built. Can you turn this dangerous place into a home and survive each new wave?
